# cc2image attribution

The JOTO WeChat visual planning adapter is derived from the workflow concepts,
style taxonomy, and prompt design patterns in `izscc/cc2image`.

- Source: https://github.com/izscc/cc2image
- Locked baseline commit: `33b18b399fcfc6a54a7c4cc2d137fa3dfd3afad8`
- License: MIT
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 izscc

Production runtime does not fetch or execute the upstream repository. Upstream
updates are adopted only through an explicit diff and local regression tests.
